analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. The patch adds a CI-runner-lane sentence that each provider test shard routes through its own lane `test-provider-K`, with a link to build.md#ci-runner-routing. It also expands the routed-job check description to cover per-shard lanes matching the job matrix, fallback, timeout and read-only permissions, and literal Blacksmith runners for release workflows. I examined the two base text units (lines 1843-2535) that surround the changed ranges. They are descriptive test documentation: CPU-only fixtures, hardware qualification gates, prefix tenant partition checks and SSD prefix record encoding checks. They describe no executable behavior. No source, protocol, key handling, attestation, cache storage or authorization code changes. The T-041 prefix-cache material in the unchanged context is described as tests and does not alter the SSD tier's TTL, HMAC lookup tags or tenant salt scoping. No security control or threat-model assumption is changed, so no finding qualifies. The lane routing and the read-only permission claims reference CI workflow configuration and scripts that are outside the supplied evidence (build.md#ci-runner-routing, the workflow files, the routing plane). Their actual enforcement is unverified here, but this is a documentation statement, not a demonstrated regression. No threat-model update is needed.
